questions.q: Protecting the environment is a Fundamental Duty under:
questions.explanation: **51A(g)**; Article 48A is the Directive Principle on the environment.

questions.q: How many States have a Legislative Council?
questions.explanation: **Six**: Maharashtra, U.P., Bihar, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Karnataka.

questions.q:
Consider the following about Legislative Councils:
1. Parliament creates or abolishes a Council by ordinary law under Article 169.
2. The State Assembly must first pass a resolution by a two-thirds majority.
Which is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Both are correct; such a law is **not** treated as a constitutional amendment under Article 368.

questions.q: What share of a Legislative Council's members are elected by graduates?
questions.explanation: **1/12** by graduates and 1/12 by teachers; 1/3 by local bodies, 1/3 by MLAs, 1/6 nominated.

questions.q: A member of a Legislative Council serves a term of:
questions.explanation: **6 years**; one-third retire every 2 years. The Council is never dissolved.

questions.q: On a Money Bill, a Legislative Council can:
options: Send it to a joint sitting
questions.explanation: It can only **recommend** within **14 days** (Article 198).

questions.q: Bicameral legislatures in six provinces were created by the:
questions.explanation: The **GoI Act, 1935**.

questions.q: Tamil Nadu's Legislative Council was abolished in 1986 when the CM was:
questions.explanation: **MGR**. Andhra Pradesh abolished its Council in 1985 (NTR) and re-created it in 2007.

questions.q: The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) replaced which law from 1 July 2024?
questions.explanation: The **CrPC, 1973**. BNS replaced the IPC; BSA the Evidence Act.

questions.q: VB-G RAM G, which replaced MGNREGA in 2026, stands for:
options: Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin)
Vikas Bharat Gram Rozgar Abhiyan Mission Grameen
Viksit Bharat Gramin Rozgar Aur Majdoori
Vishwas Bharat Guarantee for Rural Assets Mission
questions.explanation: **Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin)**, under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025.

questions.q: How many questions does Census 2027 have?
questions.explanation: **40** questions (13 new); India's first digital census.

questions.q: Who is the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India (2026)?
questions.explanation: **Mritunjay Kumar Narayan**.

questions.q: In Census 2027's caste question, which statement is correct?
options: Caste is asked only of SCs and STs
There is a separate OBC column
questions.explanation: SC/ST pick from a list; **others type their caste**; there is no separate OBC column; Aadhaar is optional.

questions.q: 'Census' is a subject in which list, and which law governs it?
options: State List; Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969
questions.explanation: **Union List, Entry 69**; the **Census Act, 1948**.

questions.q: The Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025 merged how many older laws?
questions.explanation: **Four** older laws.

questions.q: In a Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI), a reading above 50 indicates:
questions.explanation: **Expansion**. India's manufacturing PMI was 54.7 in October.

questions.q: The Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024 replaced the:
questions.explanation: The **Aircraft Act, 1934**. New fare rules under it were notified on 31 Oct 2026.

questions.q: The Bharat Renewable Energy Summit & Expo 2026 was held at:
questions.explanation: **Bharat Mandapam**, New Delhi, 2-5 Nov.

questions.q: GRAP (Graded Response Action Plan) in Delhi-NCR is run by:
questions.explanation: The **Commission for Air Quality Management**; GRAP has four stages.

questions.q: The precautionary and polluter-pays principles were set out in the:
questions.explanation: The **Rio Declaration (1992)**.

questions.q: The Siang Upper Multipurpose Project is in:
questions.explanation: **Arunachal Pradesh**, planned at 11.2 GW. The Yarlung Tsangpo becomes the Brahmaputra.

questions.q: Cyclone Murasu made landfall in Nov 2026 in which State?
questions.explanation: **Andhra Pradesh**, between Ongole and Nellore.

questions.q: Who is Iran's Foreign Minister (2026)?
questions.explanation: **Abbas Araghchi**; Esmaeil Baqaei is the spokesman.

questions.q: Israel's Knesset has how many seats?
questions.explanation: **120**; 61 for a majority; 3.25% threshold.

questions.q: India's relationship with Vietnam is classed as a:
questions.explanation: **Enhanced Comprehensive Strategic Partnership**. NSA Ajit Doval held talks in Hanoi.

questions.q: Contracts for 8 Next Generation Corvettes were split between GRSE and which shipyard?
questions.explanation: **GRSE** builds 5 and **Goa Shipyard** 3 (₹53,866.50 crore).

questions.q: The 2026 Kavli Prize in astrophysics was for discovering:
options: Past mergers of the Milky Way
questions.explanation: Belokurov, Helmi and Ibata found the **Milky Way's past galaxy mergers**.

questions.q: Which spacecraft carried Laika, the first animal to orbit Earth?
questions.explanation: **Sputnik 2**, launched 3 Nov 1957.

questions.q: The first probe to Mercury was:
questions.explanation: **Mariner 10**, launched 3 Nov 1973.

questions.q: Forced labour is prohibited by which Article?
questions.explanation: **Article 23**; law: Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1976.

questions.q: Who is the Solicitor-General of India (2026)?
questions.explanation: **Tushar Mehta**; R. Venkataramani is Attorney General.

questions.q: The Statue of Unity, inaugurated in 2018, is how tall?
questions.explanation: **182 m**, at Ekta Nagar, Gujarat.

questions.q: Who became the youngest Formula One world champion in 2026?
questions.explanation: **Kimi Antonelli** (Mercedes, Italy), at 20 years 68 days.

questions.q: Before Antonelli, the last Italian F1 world champion was:
questions.explanation: **Alberto Ascari** (1953). Previous youngest champion: Sebastian Vettel.

questions.q: Which Australian all-rounder retired from international cricket in Nov 2026?
questions.explanation: **Glenn Maxwell**: 7 Tests, 149 ODIs, 130 T20Is.

questions.q: The Second Administrative Reforms Commission (2007) suggested turning Legislative Councils into:
options: Elected upper houses with money powers
questions.explanation: **Councils of local governments**, elected by local body members.

questions.q: Under the Tenth Schedule, an independent member who joins a party after the election:
questions.explanation: Para 2(2): he is **disqualified**; the Presiding Officer decides.

questions.q: Section 163 of the BNSS (prohibitory orders) replaces which CrPC section?
questions.explanation: Old **Section 144**.

questions.q: State Election Commissions are constitutional bodies under:
questions.explanation: **243K** (panchayats) and **243ZA** (municipalities).

questions.q: The NDRF is a statutory force under the:
questions.explanation: The **Disaster Management Act, 2005**.

questions.q: The SC called the right to religious freedom under Art. 25(1):
questions.explanation: A **qualified** right, limited by public order, morality and health.

questions.q: Peaceful assembly is guaranteed by which Article?
questions.explanation: **Art. 19(1)(b)**; speech is 19(1)(a). Both carry reasonable restrictions.

questions.q: Which party expelled Mokama MLA Anant Singh for six years?
questions.explanation: **JD(U)**, for opposing the party's candidate.

questions.q: Amit Shah claimed the SIR removed about how many names?
questions.explanation: About **13 crore** by his count, including 4.25 crore double entries — his claim, not official data.

questions.q: How many appellate tribunals will use e-signed ECINet orders in West Bengal?
questions.explanation: **19** tribunals; over 38 lakh of about 60 lakh cases are pending.

questions.q: Under the new VB-G RAM G grievance rules, a complaint must be resolved within:
questions.explanation: **15 days**, after an inquiry within 7 days.

questions.q: How many IAS officers did Kerala transfer in the November reshuffle?
questions.explanation: **35**; K.R. Jyothilal became Additional Chief Secretary (Home and Vigilance).

questions.q: Who said 'fiscal prudence is non-negotiable' while defending public capex?
questions.explanation: Finance Minister **Nirmala Sitharaman**.

questions.q: Tamil Nadu's capital expenditure is under what share of GSDP?
questions.explanation: Under **1.5% of GSDP**; committed spending takes about two-thirds of revenue receipts.

questions.q: The RBI's KYC update camps run until:
questions.explanation: **31 December 2026**, from 21 October.

questions.q: The Congress sought a JPC probe into the sale of which bank?
questions.explanation: **IDBI Bank**, being sold to Canada's Fairfax Financial Holdings.

questions.q: Which stock jumped 11.6% after its Q2 FY27 results?
questions.explanation: **Reliance Industries**, lifting the Sensex 1.7%.

questions.q: Who objected to N. Chandrasekaran's third term in a letter to Noel Tata?
questions.explanation: **Darius Khambata**, writing to Tata Trusts chairman Noel Tata.

questions.q: US firm Vultr opened a 20-MW AI supercluster in which city?
questions.explanation: **Chennai**, with about 10,000 AMD MI355X GPUs.

questions.q: The Vedanta arbitration upheld by the SC concerns which oilfield?
questions.explanation: The **Ravva** field in the Krishna-Godavari basin; the award was about $99 million.

questions.q: Russia's LNG exports rose 13.4% in 2026, helped by which project?
questions.explanation: **Arctic LNG 2**; exports reached 28 million tonnes.

questions.q: Natural rubber (RSS-4) hit a record price of:
questions.explanation: **₹300 per kg**, the Rubber Board price.

questions.q: On day two of Delhi's entry ban, how many vehicles were turned back?
The SC allowed green crackers in Delhi-NCR on which dates?
questions.explanation: **7 and 8 November**, from 6-7 a.m. and 8-10 p.m.

questions.q: Crackers were banned within how many metres of hospitals and schools?
questions.explanation: **300 m** — 'no-cracker zones'.

questions.q: Which two bodies certify green cracker manufacturers?
questions.explanation: **CSIR-NEERI** and **PESO**; boxes carry QR codes.

questions.q: Which country bans private firecrackers outright?
questions.explanation: **Singapore**; Germany and Sweden require permits.

questions.q: What killed cheetah cub KNG22 at Kuno National Park?
questions.explanation: A task force found it was shot by **recreational hunters**.

questions.q: Indonesia's 2026 wildfires burned about how much land?
questions.explanation: **1.9 million hectares**, mostly peatland, worsened by El Nino and the Indian Ocean Dipole.

questions.q: Meghalaya's October rainfall deficit was:
questions.explanation: **85%** — 38.3 mm against a normal of 255 mm.

questions.q: The Ravva oilfield lies in which basin?
questions.explanation: The **Krishna-Godavari** basin, offshore Andhra Pradesh.

questions.q: The Houthis claimed a drone attack on which Saudi airport?
questions.explanation: **Dammam** airport.

questions.q: Who chairs the UN Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory?
questions.explanation: **Justice S. Muralidhar**, a former Indian High Court judge.

questions.q: Kansas has not elected a Democratic senator since:
Which ceasefire, brokered by Melania Trump, collapsed in Ukraine?
questions.explanation: The local **Oleshky** ceasefire; Russia resumed strikes on Kherson.

questions.q: India and China share what arrangement on river waters?
options: No water treaty, only emergency flood data
questions.explanation: **No treaty** — China shares flood data only in emergencies.

questions.q: UK care workers who arrived before May 2025 can seek settlement after:
questions.explanation: **5 years** (instead of 15) if they earn £25,000 or more.

questions.q: How did India vote on the UNGA resolution against the US embargo on Cuba?
questions.explanation: **In favour**, as in previous years.

questions.q: How many Next Generation Corvettes were contracted for ₹53,866.50 crore?
questions.explanation: **8** — GRSE builds 5 and Goa Shipyard 3.

questions.q: Delhi Police personnel protested the transfer of which officer?
questions.explanation: **ACP Manasvi Vashistha**, after a scuffle with lawyers.

questions.q: The ED searched the premises of which former Punjab minister?
questions.explanation: **Sunder Sham Arora**, under the PMLA.

questions.q: The DPDP Act's rules come fully into force in:
questions.explanation: **May 2027**; the rules were notified in November 2025.

questions.q: UCLA's optical-electronic deepfake detector is how accurate on fake videos?
questions.explanation: **99.86%** on fakes and 95.72% on real videos, using 7x less energy.

questions.q: Cigarette smoke silences which gene in lung organoids (*PNAS*)?
questions.explanation: **Zbp1**; a Kras mutation then drives adenocarcinoma.

questions.q: Which signal was adopted internationally at Berlin in 1906?
questions.explanation: **SOS**; Alzheimer presented his patient the same year.

questions.q: Hackers raised supermarket freezer temperatures to 50°C in which country?
questions.explanation: **Sweden** and other European countries.

questions.q: Under the SC's bonded labour order, aid must reach a freed worker within:
questions.explanation: **7 days**; complaints must be verified in 24 hours.

questions.q: Under which law was the Kasaragod paediatrician sentenced to 47 years?
questions.explanation: The **POCSO Act**; 47 years, running concurrently as 20.

questions.q: India Hate Lab recorded 60 attacks on Christians in which State?
questions.explanation: **West Bengal**, between 13 May and 20 September.

questions.q: The November 2026 refinery fire was at which HPCL facility?
questions.explanation: The **Visakh Refinery**, Visakhapatnam; no casualties.

questions.q: Who will captain India A in the ACC Men's Rising Stars Asia Cup?
questions.explanation: **Tilak Varma**.

questions.q: Which team won the 2025-26 Ranji Trophy?
questions.explanation: **Jammu & Kashmir**, under Paras Dogra.

questions.q: The Archery Premier League uses a shot clock of:
questions.explanation: **15 seconds**, against 20 seconds at World Cups.

questions.q: The 10th leg of the Indian Golf Premier League Season 2 was held at:
questions.explanation: **Visakhapatnam**.

questions.q: Which Coast Guard ship rescued a fisherman off Mangaluru?
questions.explanation: **ICGS C-448**, about 100 km offshore.

questions.q: Who is Indonesia's President (2026)?
questions.explanation: **Prabowo Subianto**.

questions.q: India beat Korea by what margin in the Asian Champions Trophy league match?
questions.explanation: **8-0** at Jalandhar; the knockouts moved to Mohali.
